{{Top}}
[[File:Lifeform_scanner.jpg|thumb|Imperial scanning technologies could get through any kind of electronic concealment.]]
A '''life-form scanner''', also known as a '''life-form sensor''' or '''lifeform detection module''', or a '''life-form detector'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a device that allowed the holder to detect living ([[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient) beings from a distance. A large majority of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] used this technology to lock on to enemies and potential [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]. Lifeform scanners could also detect beings hidden by [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]], [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth fields]], and [[sound dampener]]s. A large manufacturer of lifeform scanners was [[Idellian Arrays/Legends|Idellian Arrays]].

[[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] was equipped with a life-form scanner as part of its standard equipment.<ref name="EGTD" />

They were equipped onboard [[Guardian-class patrol ship|''Guardian''-class patrol ships]].
